'''Tubrimi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], he served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the cruiser [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']] during the [[Battle of Mindor]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sir! We don’t have engines—we don’t even have repulsorlifts. You’re not actually suggesting we take this—this fragment of a ship into atmosphere with nothing but attitude thrusters—"<br />"That’s right. I’m not suggesting. I’m ordering. And I’m not just taking us into the atmosphere. I’m going to land this thing.|Tubrimi and Luke Skywalker as the ''Justice'' breaks apart.|<ref name="SoM" />}}
As Skywalker's fleet was approaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], Lieutenant Tubrimi was stationed onboard the cruiser [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']]. When Shadowspawn was willing to make a truce, Skywalker eventually consulted with his officers and came to the conclusion that Tubrimi should notify the ship. This, however, did not go well when the ''Justice'' was split apart by a [[gravity bomb]]. Kalback was killed, and Tubrimi suffered a minor injury from his shoulder and ordered the evacuation along with Skywalker. When Skywalker decided to move the remains of the ship to the surface of the planet, Tubrimi expressed concerns, but eventually agreed to his will.

Tubrimi and the surviving crew of the ''Justice’s'' command bridge crash landed near a ring of half-fused volcanic rock on Mindor. There, Tubrimi worked alongside Skywalker to ensure the wreckage of the ''Justice'' was rendered unsalvageable, lest Shadowspawn’s forces attempted to reverse engineer the next-gen Mon Calamari technology within the [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]].

After this, Tubrimi ordered the survivors to make for a system of nearby [[Cave/Legends|caves]] that fellow survivor, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sthonnart]], had been ordered to secure. But upon rendezvousing at the caves, Tubrimi found Sthonnart and his corpsmen missing. Before he could deduce what had become of Sthonnart’s unit, Tubrimi and the bridge survivors were ambushed by [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow troopers]]; the lieutenant was abducted in the ensuing skirmish. Under orders from [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]], Tubrimi and the captured crew of the ''Justice'' were dumped into a cave of [[Melter|Melters]].<ref name="SoM" />
